hooks.text: 可任意上调或下调英雄、武器和技能的数值，用双向改造重写每局规则与构筑
hooks.excerpt: Boosting lets you increase or decrease any value of your hero, weapons and abilities, giving you complete freedom to reinterpret the game in new and exciting ways.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 十二种起始武器与法术继续叠加普通和传奇升级，传奇强化还会解锁新的改造方式
hooks.excerpt: 12 unique starting weapons and spells. Tons of upgrades to them, but we don't want to spoil just how many. Even more legendary upgrades that give new ways to boost your hero.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 穿越敌群试炼抵达最终首领后，还能把生存成绩投入全球排行榜竞争
hooks.excerpt: An intimidating gauntlet of enemies on your journey to the final boss. A global Leaderboard to compete for the spot of top survivor.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
